questions.q:
*(Refer to the comprehension passage in Question 31)*

Based on the spatial layout described in the passage, why are the small irrigation channels placed at the **back edge** of each step?
options: To hide the water supply from young people leaving the village.
To ensure that heavy rainfall washes the soil directly over the edge.
To stop crops from absorbing any compost-enriched soil.
To allow water to trickle down gradually without breaking the stone walls.
questions.explain: The passage explicitly states the spatial purpose: 'small irrigation channels are dug at the back edge of each step, ensuring that water trickles down gradually from the highest terrace to the lowest without breaking the stone walls.'
